batch: WL99A - Workload qualification protocol review and amendment for the RB-DTO-E investigation
relation_to_WL99: WL99 (rbdto99_v1) results, verdict STOPPED_WORKLOAD_UNQUALIFIED, protocol files and reference outputs are preserved unchanged. v2 is a separately versioned qualification protocol. Stage 1-3 rules of v1 are inherited unchanged except where noted.
status: FROZEN before any v2 value is computed on any candidate and before any diagnostic higher-resolution render (the v2 metric was validated only on synthetic images, tests99a.py)

diagnosis.D1_reproduce: recompute the WL99 Q3 (edge width, contrast) from the stored 384 references with the WL99 code; must equal qual99.json
diagnosis.D2_resolution: matched scene / camera / transport references at 768 px (8192 spp per half, two halves) for T0 and T1 of all 15 WL99 candidates; WL99 Q3 and Q3 v2 at 384 and 768; for candidates whose Q3v2 C changes by > 0.20 between 384 and 768, T0 also at 1536 (4096 spp per half)
diagnosis.D3_noise: WL99 Q3 edge width recomputed on single halves vs the half mean (spp halved) and, where both exist, at 16384 vs 65536 per half; the noise / signal gradient ratio (diag_q3)
diagnosis.D4_definition: WL99 Q3 and Q3 v2 on synthetic images of known structure (tests99a.py: smooth ramp, lambda_c sinusoid, sub-pixel step, noise only, silhouette), incl. the WL99 metric's response to a physically sharp step at 384 and 768
diagnosis.D5_localisation: maps of |Sd_T1 - Sd_stale| (where the higher-order transport change lies) and of the v2 high-pass residual, per candidate
diagnosis.classification: per candidate, the WL99 Q3 failure is attributed to A (insufficient structure: v2 C < c_min with a converged, reliable estimate), B (under-resolved: v2 C not converged 384 -> 768, or WL99 edge width ~constant in px across resolutions), C (noise: WL99 width changes with spp / halves while v2 C is reliable), D (definition: WL99 rejects although v2 structure + resolved + reliable pass)

Q3_v2.lambda_c_rationale: the coarsest spatial cell of the frozen WL99 Stage 1 precomputed comparator ladder (TwinP h_x = 0.02 m): the scale a coarse precomputed representation averages away
Q3_v2.c_min_rationale: WL99 Stage 1 tier tau1 = 0.05 (relative RMSE): structure whose removal costs less than the tier cannot discriminate sharp transport
Q3_v2.C_definition: sqrt(max(0, sum_ROI H(A) H(B)) / sum_ROI A B), H = S - G_s(S) with s = lambda_c / sqrt(12) / footprint (mask-normalised Gaussian); A, B independent reference halves (luminance of Sd); ROI = WL99 ROI_self eroded by 3 px (scaled with resolution) away from non-body pixels
Q3_v2.structure: C >= 0.05 at T0 and at T1
Q3_v2.resolved: lambda_c >= 4 px at the evaluation resolution r and |C_r - C_2r| / C_2r <= 0.20; r = smallest of {384, 768} satisfying this
Q3_v2.reliable: block-bootstrap SE(C) <= 0.25 C (32 px blocks at 384, scaled)
Q3_v2.angular: WL99 exact-direction angular criterion kept unchanged
Q3_v2.footprint: median over ROI pixels of d * (2 tan(fov / 2) / r) / sqrt(cos theta) (d hit distance, theta angle between the view ray and the surface normal)

other_gates: Q_ref, Q1, Q4, Q5, Q6 exactly as rbdto99_v1, measured at 384 as in WL99. Implementation change: the co-moved reference (Q4) is rendered at the same spp per half as the T0 reference it is compared with (WL99 compared a 16384-spp co-moved reference with a 65536-spp T0 under a limit that counts only T0 noise); thresholds unchanged.

candidate_sets.development: the 15 WL99 candidates (all inspected during WL99): eligibility re-evaluated under v2 (and v1 values reproduced)
candidate_sets.independent_heldout: 8 candidates from gen_indep99a.py (seed 990901), generated and frozen before any render; never inspected before their qualification run

required_set_v2: development: >= 1 admitted A (S1) and >= 1 admitted B (S2); C null (WL99 C_box, re-checked); independent: >= 1 admitted A on a non-groove geometry (held-out geometry) and >= 1 further admitted A or B (held-out illumination / pose); Q6 intrusion as in WL99 (A1, A6 or A10)

stop.STOPPED_PROTOCOL_UNREPAIRABLE: v2 cannot be defined without outcome-dependent thresholds, or references cannot support it (reliable fails for the candidates under the spp budget)
stop.STOPPED_WORKLOAD_UNQUALIFIED: required_set_v2 not met (no new candidates beyond the 8 independent ones are generated in this batch)
stop.downstream: if required_set_v2 is met, Stage 1-3 of rbdto99_v1 run on the admitted workloads with their v2 evaluation resolution, under their original gates (G1a, G1b) and stop conditions
